rewrites: Pad the result to eight bins with a public logical count; at most eight nonempty bins fit in eight input elements.

Replace dynamic reshape and row means by guarded static reductions over the eight input elements. Division of a Q32 sum by a positive integer uses CirC native unsigned integer division with sign conversion; it requires no wide Q32-by-Q32 division gadget.

encoding: Private inputs; public return value. Real numbers are rounded to scale 2^32. Native u64 values use signed two-complement interpretation; integer arithmetic is used for candidate full-width Q32 products to avoid truncating them to 64 bits before rescaling.
reason: Eight-bin capacity; guarded sums and native integer division by bin size.
